data.description:
SURFACE: /submissions/<id> PARTICIPANTS panel, and /submissions/new.

WHAT BREAKS: Co-presenters cannot be attached to a submission from the organizer side at all. The record renders a full PARTICIPANTS panel but offers no add/remove/edit affordance, and the organizer create form has exactly one person slot ('Submitter REQUIRED'). The only participant-entry path is the public form's single fixed co-speaker name/email pair, which has no role picker.

CONFIRMED AT LIVE SHA 75b871d94c6f:
- src/ui/submissions/SubmissionRecordPage.tsx:231 -> the Participants Card maps record.participants and renders an empty state; there is no mutation control anywhere in the file. grep for add-participant across src/ui/submissions/ returns nothing.
- The public CFP form exposes exactly one co-speaker pair: fields co_speaker_name and co_speaker_email (GET /api/v1/public/forms/cfp on live).
- Yet that same live response declares form.max_speakers: 4. The form's own contract allows four people; the form can only ever collect two.

FIX SHAPE: an add-participant control on the record (person picker + role), and either honour max_speakers with repeatable co-speaker slots on the public form or stop advertising 4.

WHY URGENT: multi-presenter sessions are ordinary at a conference of this kind, and the max_speakers:4 vs one-slot contradiction is a self-inflicted inconsistency a reader of the API will notice.

SIZE: medium.

PROVENANCE: sbek run 2026-08-12T15-33-34, abstract-management judgement, defects[3]. Validated live.
data.title: A submission's participants are read-only: no way to add a co-presenter after intake

data.body:
Validated against a real local build (npx vite build + wrangler dev on the seeded demo DB, build 1058ed23caf7 + this branch), driven through the c11 embedded browser as an organizer.

ORGANIZER HALF — /submissions/sub_synthetic-pool-0900:
- The PARTICIPANTS panel now carries an add control (search-existing / add-new tabs, role picker) and a Remove on every non-submitter row.
- Typed 'Aar' into the picker: live server-side search returned Aarush Selvan et al. Selected him, role Co Speaker, Add -> row appeared.
- Repeated with Indra Alder as Moderator through the UI. Reloaded the page: both still there, with the roles chosen (Aarush = Co Speaker, Indra = Moderator).
- Add-new-person tab: Jordan Pike / jordan.pike@example.com as Chairperson -> person created and attached in one action.
- Remove on Jordan Pike -> row gone; reloaded -> still gone, other three intact.
- Error path seen for real: with an expired session the POST 401s and the message renders inline in the panel ('Your session has expired...') while the record stays on screen -- it does not blow the record away the way the shared act() helper would.

PUBLIC FORM HALF (honest number, not repeatable slots):
- GET /api/v1/public/forms/cfp on the local build now returns max_speakers 2 while the forms row still stores 4; participant fields are speaker_* plus exactly one co_speaker_* pair.
- /f/cfp reads 'Include at least one participant; this form has one optional co-speaker slot.' -- that sentence is now derived from the advertised number rather than hardcoded.

TESTS: tests/integration/api/participants-editable.MRQ-139.test.ts -- 8/8 fail on the pre-fix tree (routes 404; advertised max 4), 8/8 pass after. Full npm test: 866/867, the single failure being decided-not-notified.AC-268-269 timing out at 20s under load from the dev server + browser + sibling agents; it passes 4/4 when run alone, and an earlier full run of the same tree exited 0.

PR open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/122 (branch mrq-139-participants-editable, commit c07adb8c). Organizer half built in full (POST/DELETE participants + panel controls); public half landed as the honest advertised number rather than repeatable co-speaker slots, stated plainly in the PR body.

Gate + review status, so the next reader does not have to re-derive it.

PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/122 (commit c07adb8c).

npm run pr-gate -> FAIL, on time alone. Every non-test step passed (check:shell-truth, check:design, check:api, check:routes, check:clocks, merged AC trace). The test step reported 2 red out of 867: reset-demo.test.ts AC-230 and decided-not-notified.AC-268-269 -- both 'Test timed out in 20000ms', not assertion failures, in a run that took 421s against the 45s objective while the machine sat at load average ~200 with 30+ sibling agent processes. Neither test touches participants, the submission record, or the public form contract.

Re-ran those two files together with tests/integration/api/participants-editable.MRQ-139.test.ts in isolation: 3 files, 16/16 passed, exit 0. The gate red is contention, exactly the case CLAUDE.md says to check the load before believing.

Code review has now timed out twice at 600s (auto-fired at 20:38, re-run at 20:49), both 'Agent claude timed out after 600s'. That is the same starvation. A third attempt is running. I am not merging on a timed-out review -- the project rule is that someone other than the author reads the diff, and a timeout read nothing.

PR #122 body now carries an explicit gate note: what I ran locally and passed (tsc both configs, vite build, check:design/api/routes/clocks/shell-truth, merged AC trace, my own test file red-then-green), what was red and why it is not this diff (two 20s timeouts under load ~200; 16/16 green when re-run isolated), and what I could not earn (an independent read of the diff -- the review agent timed out at 600s twice). Filed rather than merged, deliberately.

Independent review came back PASS (artifact art_01KZVWRJ8SWZ8V6NCSAQM781RD, third attempt -- the first two were starved out at 600s). Reviewer ran the test file (8/8) and tsc themselves rather than only reading the diff, and cross-checked the role enum against the DB CHECK constraint and the search response shape against search.routes.ts.

Four MINOR findings, all now fixed in 60b4b623:
- idempotent add answered 201 while creating nothing -> answers 200; 201 kept for a real insert.
- exists-check and INSERT were two round trips, so a race surfaced uq_participations_person_submission_role as a 500 -> ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes it atomic. New test covers the concurrent case.
- participantInput inherited position and honoured it, contradicting the append-only comment -> omitted; the server always appends.
- the public form's slot sentence counted slots even on a form with no participant fields (the one shape the server cannot clamp) -> gated on the form actually collecting participants.

Two non-defect observations recorded for later, not acted on here: min_speakers is not clamped the way max_speakers now is (same class of bug, own ticket), and the record's person picker searches the event roster rather than all org people (the add-new path dedupes by email, so no duplicates result).

Separately, Surface Surveyor caught the real fast-gate blocker: my test titles used an 'MRQ-139 · ' prefix, and trace-ac-core.mjs requires 'AC-<n> · ' or 'CONTRACT · '. Re-titled all of them; 'npm run trace:ac -- --scope=merged' now passes.

Post-fix: tsc clean on both configs, check:api pass, check:design pass, trace:ac pass, participants-editable.MRQ-139.test.ts 9/9 through the fleet serializer.

Rebased onto github/main at 2dfd378a (seven PRs landed while I was fixing test titles). Two conflicts, both feature-vs-feature rather than competing edits, so I kept both sides:
- loadRecord's actions block: MRQ-80's can_resend_decision and my can_edit_participants now sit side by side.
- SubmissionRecordPage: the same, for the actions type and the useState cluster (resendNotice next to the participant picker state).

Post-rebase on f159f0c7: tsc clean on both configs; trace:ac, check:api, check:design, check:routes all pass; participants-editable.MRQ-139 + submission-record-board = 12/12; recovery.MRQ-80 (the suite that owns the flag I merged beside) = 3/3. All through the fleet serializer at load ~42. Force-pushed with --force-with-lease.

MRQ-139 landed: PR #122 merged to main at 2026-08-12T21:32:12Z (auto-merge fired on the green rebased head f159f0c7).

WHAT SHIPPED
Organizer half, in full. Two routes under program:write -- POST /events/{eventId}/submissions/{submissionId}/participants (person_id, or name+email which matches an existing org person by address rather than duplicating) and DELETE .../participants/{participationId} (submitter refused, 422). Idempotent add answers 200; a genuine insert answers 201; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against uq_participations_person_submission_role makes the idempotency atomic so a double-click cannot surface as a 500. Position is server-owned: additions append and never reorder. Both writes audit in the same batch, so History reads 'Participant Added' / 'Participant Removed' with actor and time. loadRecord gained can_edit_participants, computed from the same grant the routes enforce.

UI: the create screen's person picker (event search, or an add-new-person tab), a role select covering co_speaker/speaker/moderator/chairperson/sponsor_contact, and Remove on every non-submitter row. Participant writes report inline rather than through act(), so a refused add does not destroy the record being read. .record-person-foot reserves 25px so the submitter's card (no Remove) matches the removable ones -- elements never jump.

Public half, deliberately narrow: the advertised max_speakers is now clamped to what the form's fields can actually collect (2 where the row stores 4), the validator enforces that same clamped ceiling so the two cannot drift, and the form's slot sentence derives from it and is suppressed entirely on a form with no participant fields. REPEATABLE CO-SPEAKER SLOTS WERE NOT BUILT -- stated plainly in the PR body. That remains open work.

FILES: src/routes/submission-record.routes.ts, src/routes/public-form.{routes,shared}.ts, src/ui/submissions/{SubmissionRecordPage.tsx,record.css}, src/ui/public/form/PublicForm.tsx, tests/integration/api/participants-editable.MRQ-139.test.ts. No migration -- participations already held everything needed.

EVIDENCE: the test file was verified red before the fix (8/8 fail: routes 404, advertised max 4) and green after (9/9 with the race case added). Live validation on a real built Worker against the seeded demo DB, driven in a browser: added a co-speaker and a moderator from the directory, created and attached a new chairperson, removed one, reloaded each time and saw roles persist; confirmed the public form contract and copy. Independent review PASS (art_01KZVWRJ8SWZ8V6NCSAQM781RD) with four minor findings, all fixed before merge. Post-rebase: tsc clean both configs, trace:ac/check:api/check:design/check:routes pass, 12/12 on my tests plus submission-record-board, 3/3 on recovery.MRQ-80 whose can_resend_decision I merged beside. CI green on f159f0c7.

LEFT FOR OTHERS (from the review, not acted on here): min_speakers is not clamped the way max_speakers now is, so a form configured min_speakers:3 with two collectable slots stays unsatisfiable -- same class of bug, deserves its own ticket. And the record's person picker searches the event roster rather than all org people; the add-new path dedupes by email so no duplicate results, but the picker's coverage is narrower than 'everyone in the organization'.
